decision: No current executor acquires durable retry authority from this census. Admission requires the future signed durable profile and adapter tests.

entries.name: find_files
entries.output_schema: entries with path, name, kind, size and mtime plus source-completeness metadata
entries.automatic_retry: eligible only after a sealed-inventory adapter rechecks source identity and truncation

entries.name: read_files_ocr
entries.output_schema: ok, entries, failed, counts and explicit partial/truncated markers
entries.effect: manifest policy unknown; observed operations are reads plus local subprocesses and bounded VLM fallback
entries.placement: server by the current manifest default; durable device placement is not declared
entries.automatic_retry: not admitted until the durable adapter makes one source one unit and preserves partial failures

entries.name: describe_images
entries.output_schema: ok, entries, counts, partial and structured error fields
entries.effect: manifest policy unknown; observed operation is read-only VLM inference
entries.automatic_retry: not admitted until model binding, prompt digest and transient-error classes are frozen

entries.name: extract_entries
entries.preset_role: structured answer candidate over observed text
entries.output_schema: typed entry collection with bounded extraction diagnostics
entries.automatic_retry: interactive from_step arguments are incompatible with durable references; a dedicated adapter or workload is required

entries.name: describe_entries
entries.output_schema: content or structured entries with truncation and structured error fields
entries.effect: manifest policy unknown; observed operation is model inference over supplied entries
entries.automatic_retry: not admitted until hierarchical fan-in, canonical order, prompt digest and truncation semantics are explicit

entries.name: create_images_indices
entries.preset_role: specialist reference implementation; excluded from the generic preset
entries.output_schema: index counters, model identifiers and truncation diagnostics
entries.automatic_retry: rejected: the current final index write is atomic, but per-image work is not committed in the generic store

entries.name: write_files_doc
entries.preset_role: external publication candidate; excluded from v1
entries.output_schema: document identifier and appended character range
entries.effect: manifest policy unknown; observed operation mutates a remote document
entries.automatic_retry: rejected: append has no accepted durable idempotency key and cannot be retried blindly

closed_gaps.current_tier_rule: The plan stores a registered logical workload. The workload registry resolves fast, middle, wise, creative or frontier; precise is not a tier key.
closed_gaps.internal_publication: v1 writes only to the owner-scoped Metnos artifact store
closed_gaps.external_publication: requires a later signed idempotent or reconcilable executor contract
